comments.author: triyambakam
comments.story: All you need is λ, part one: booleans
comments.why: Intro to combinators and Church encodings with JavaScript equivalents
comments.text: Just last night I found this excellent introduction to the Lambda Calculus by Gabriel Lebec [1]. It's one of the best I've come across and covers briefly history, building up combinators (using Smullyan's names) leading up to implementing Church encodings and gives Javascript equivalents (or approximations when not possible). The slides themselves are also very aesthetically pleasing, Gabriel has a good sense of colour and design [1] [VIDEO]
